value.rationale: Maximum degree captures immediate reach or hub status, while minimum eccentricity is the classical minimax location criterion. The first network size where these two unambiguous choices can conflict is therefore a natural structural benchmark, and the complete two-class first layer plus the closeness tie gives additional explanatory structure rather than a bare counterexample.
